Episode 217. The Reason Ayula Manifested (2)
At Ayula's words, the pupils of the three widened.
"Right now? Ayula, are you saying that Zito is going to appear in the kingdom now?"
[Yes, to find his eyes.]

In the kingdom, Zito's eyes, which were most needed for his 'completion,' were being stored. Because of these eyes, Talaris, even after Elona escaped the seal, faced a lot of restrictions in her actions.
"Lord Ayula, wouldn't there be a problem with the eyes simply because Zito appears near the kingdom?"

[It seems you're worried about Bi Kung Ju who was helping stabilize Lani's eyes, Jin. As I'm currently manifested, Zito's energy can't reach the inside of the kingdom. Even if he's recovered more power than I anticipated, it's not enough to annihilate me. She will be safe today.]
"Hmm, that demon. Suddenly barges in without any notice. So Ayula, what should we do now? Should we fight him to help you?"
"If necessary, we will immediately summon all the superhuman forces of the alliance."
Jin and Murakan said simultaneously. Ayula stroked Jin's head with one wing, as if she found him admirable.

[I think it would be better to end today's battle as a fight between gods. If you fight together, one of you will surely die. But even if Zito is defeated, he will never be annihilated, so it is right for you to plan for the future after I injure him today.]
"Still, just in case, wouldn't it be better to call our guys to standby? I'm worried."
[It is now when my barrier is at its strongest, so spatial jumps through human technology are impossible in the first place. You're worried... Murakan, have you forgotten who I am?]
"Forgotten, you're Ayula, the God of Peace. Extremely powerful…"
[Yes, I'm the God of Peace. That's why I have the highest level of power among the gods. It requires such ability to protect peace and order. The one who should be burdened now is not me, but Zito.]
Ayula spread out her ten pairs of wings.
[Lani, once you leave here, continue to pray with my children. Your prayers give me great strength. The fight between him and me will take place outside the barrier in the upper air of the capital.]
Lani bowed her head.
As Ayula ascended to the sky, the gray area became blurry, and the outline of Inse began to show. Jin, Murakan, and Lani were standing again in the middle of the shrine.
"Ayula... fights for us!"
"Lord Ayula!"
Those gathered in the shrine were also aware that Ayula had begun the battle with Zito. Ayula had informed the people who trusted her of the situation as she sent Jin and his party back to Inse.
"My people, I will convey the words of Lord Ayula. I will fight the enemy, so you must pray for me. Everyone, gather on the rooftop. We will all pray together."
There was a divine aura in Lani's voice. Having just been close to Ayula, her faith had deepened and strengthened.
When they climbed up to the rooftop of the shrine, they saw a golden barrier covering the night sky.
And beyond it was Ayula manifested, and in front of her was a huge rift never seen in Inse before.
Even during the Kingdom Defense War 500 years ago when Heluram summoned the demon kings, there was no rift of this scale. It was a testament to the authority and power Zito held.
Zito slowly revealed himself from the rift. His huge face, shimmering in purple, looked like a dragon, with seven horns protruding.
If Ayula wasn't here.
Ordinary humans would have lost their minds and become invalid just by beholding Zito's form. Ayula's energy and barrier were blocking the influence of Zito.
"A malignant spirit, or the King of the Black Sea, Gliek. You're saying there's something darker and more terrifying than them…"
"This is seriously tense. How can something like that exist?"
Ayula, who appeared so sacred and massive, now felt relatively small.
"You two should observe the fight."
"We also want to support Lord Ayula. Can't we pray together?"

"Anyway, the prayer without faith wouldn't have much effect. Most importantly, both of you will have to fight that terrifying being in the future… it would be beneficial to observe his abilities. Lord Ayula would also want that."
Jin and Murakan nodded.

The believers, without any specific direction or control, took their places in order and knelt on the ground. Everyone started to pray following Lani, and a golden energy rose above the barrier. The energy connected to the back of Ayula.
In the meantime, Zito pushed Ayula's energy and escaped the rift. He too, like Ayula, had ten pairs of wings.
[Ayula... it's been a long time.]
[You should know well that this land is not permitted for you, Zito. Go back to your place.]
[Bring me my eyes. Then, today, you won't have to be humiliated in front of your lowly followers.]
"How foolish, Zito. Since the beginning of the Age of Mortality, no one who has angered me has had a good outcome, and you will be no different."
"The Age of Mortality… I see you see this world, left behind by the sun god, as such. I will bring an end to that turbid and noisy age. By me, Zito. Pain will complete you!"
Zito and Ayula formed weapons simultaneously.
An axe full of thorns and twenty spears. Zito raised the thorny axe with one hand, and Ayula's spears floated next to each wing.
The first to attack was Ayula. As Ayula reached out, twenty spears rushed at once, but Zito did not dodge them.
His horns broke, his wings were torn, and large holes appeared all over his body.
Zito seemed to shudder in pain, but he smiled wryly and said.
"Ah… yes, this is it. This is electrifying, Ayula. How long has it been since I felt this pain?"
Ayula did not respond and continued to shoot spears to pressure him. However, he healed faster than the spears could injure him.
"Wow... That's seriously a crazy problem."
The embodiment of evil and darkness.
That's what Zito was. He loved pain, so after subjugating the demon world, he spent a long time torturing himself.
Because there was no one left in the demon world who could inflict true pain on him.
Ayula was fighting for the cause of peace and balance in Inse, but for Zito, this confrontation was simply pleasure.

"Playing alone is a lonely thing, Ayula. Indeed, to truly enjoy anything, you must do it together. Those in pain bond and share their pain. Have you ever seen a sight more beautiful than that? Why do you think I said I'd go if you just handed over my eyes? I'm so happy."
"Inse is painful enough even without a monster like you. Don't disparage the lives of the living. This world is where everyone overcomes their own pain and moves forward."
"That's why I'm so eager, Ayula. Hurt me more powerfully, more cruelly! No, not like this! Let me show you how it's done."
Zito strode through the sky towards Ayula.

"First, when you're pressuring your opponent, you move like this, slowly, slowly. That way, fear multiplies. Even though it's coming slowly, they can't escape. Shall we call it the most classic yet perfect method? And then, when you hit somewhere, like this. Bold and threatening!"
Zito's thorny axe distorted the sky and fell onto Ayula's shoulder. Flesh and golden blood splattered, but two spears were lodged in Zito's neck.
"It's not a fight between gods, but a battle between barbarians."
For a while, the situation continued like that. Despite being pierced all over by spears, Zito continued to swing his thorny axe at the same pace, and Ayula was gradually pushed back.
"Ah, how can you not scream once, my friend Ayula. I really hate beings like you. Even if I catch you and torture you for a thousand years, you would be as noble as you are now."
"There are many such people among the humans of Inse. You will never be able to break them."

"Fortunately, even guys like you have their uses. The first is to give me pain, something only noble and strong individuals can do. And the second is to be defeated like trash in front of everyone. You will be noble until that moment, but will those who trust, rely, and watch you do the same?"
"In that way, you can plant a sense of defeat deeper than any pain in their hearts."
As Zito continued speaking, he formed another thorny axe.

"The despair of the many humans who believe in you is a greater pleasure for me than your pain. Because I am starved. The quantity of pain is more important than its purity and quality. We should fill our hungry stomachs before we worry about the quality."
Tsk-!
Zito cut off one of Ayula's spears that flew into his chest. The spear shattered like glass and scattered somewhere, and Zito bit off the wing that lost the spear with his teeth.
Blood poured out like a flood from the torn wing. Ayula continued the offensive as if nothing had happened, but Zito was also emitting a stronger aura.
The primitive form of offense and defense continued. Because if they fought while dodging and blocking, they could never inflict decisive damage on each other.
To any observer, Ayula was being pushed back.
But Ayula stared at Zito without any sign of shrinking.
"Zito, look behind you."
"Why, did you prepare a gift for me behind?"
"Why do you think I've been pushed back by you till now? I did it to block the path you would retreat."
At those words, Zito looked behind for the first time with a startled expression.
The large crack he had escaped from was visibly eroded by Ayula's energy.

"You could have been confident because you could always retreat there if you felt like you were going to lose to me. And it has always been a truth that the more afraid one is, the more talkative they are. Your means of escape is gone, isn't it right to kneel before me now?"
